title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Defensive bid, semis cracked.
Comms and staples caught a haven bid while SOXX fell 5.63%, dragging the tape to a broad risk-off close with only 56% of S&P names higher. Money rotated into software (IGV +5.04%) and cybersecurity (CIBR +5.99%) even as AI hardware unwound; with 60.4% FedWatch odds of a Sep 16 hike, positioning leans defensive.

INDICES — VIX 17.1, above its 15.5 20-day MA.
RSP +0.07%, DIA -0.25%, IWM -0.34%, SPY -0.45%, QQQ -0.80%, SOXX -5.63%. Small > large by 0.11pp. WTI +1.14% was the notable cross-asset mover; gold -1.49%. SPY's 20d -1.99% keeps it near trend but no 200-DMA break flagged.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SOXX 1.6x, IWM 1.4x, IJH 1.3x gained volume; GLD 0.6x, SLV 0.8x, DIA 0.9x faded. SPY/QQQ vol_ratio not flagged elevated. SOXX vol up + price down -5.63% = distribution. Breadth: 38% above 50DMA, 56% above 200DMA, adv/dec 281/219, up/down vol 0.84, 11 highs vs 49 lows — participation diverges from headline indices.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLC Comms +2.19%, XLV Healthcare +1.45%, XLP Staples +1.25%, XLY Discretionary -0.10%, XLF Financials -0.38%, XLRE Real Estate -0.69%, XLB Materials -0.90%, XLE Energy -0.94%, XLU Utilities -1.34%, XLI Industrials -1.42%, XLK Technology -1.81%.
Top industries CIBR +5.99%, IGV +5.04%; bottom DRAM -7.28%, SOXX -5.63%. Flows: XLF +345 (65p), XLV +157 (62p) in; XLY -526 (6p), XLK -432 (8p) out — leaders XLV/XLP confirm, XLK contradicts. Rotation: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.84, QQQ PCR 1.43 (elevated protection), skew +12.7%/+15.8% (put premium). VIX 17.1 above 15.5 MA20. QQQ maxpain 700. VIXEQ 36.0 vs VIX 17.1 = wide gap, stock-pickers' tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Gold -1.49% and silver -2.20% fell despite risk-off; dollar +0.36% via UUP pressured metals. Next FOMC Sep 16: FedWatch hold 39.6%, hike 60.4%.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 50 Neutral. TER -13.30% (Zacks noted larger drop), PANW +13.09% (Sept 10 investor presentation), GEV -8.62% (GLJ Research Sell, $470 target). Vol spikes: VRT -7.65% (2.3x, distribution), BAC -5.14% (2.1x). Watch: SOXX -5.63% (1.6x vol, 200DMA proximity), QQQ -0.80% (maxpain 700 magnet), XLC +2.19% (inflow-confirmed leadership).
